column1: # Lucene's own output primitives, as known-answer vectors.
# Generated by running the judge's CodecVectors class inside the pinned
# Sling image, which drives Lucene 4.7.2's own DataOutput and packed-integer
# writers over a fixed input set:
# stdout redirected here. Columns: <primitive>\t<input>\t<bytes in hex>.
# A string's input column is escaped, non-ASCII as \uXXXX, so one case is
# The encodings these pin are specified in docs/analysis/lucene-4-7-codec.md
# sections 1 and 2. Three of them are the reason this fixture exists rather
# than a round-trip test: `vint -1` is five bytes with the sign surviving
# into the last group; a string map and a string set open with a *four-byte*
# count and not a vint; and an all-equal block-packed block carries no
# packed data at all, an all-zero one being a single token byte.
